Security review or audit before mainnet release for smart contract workstreams
Public progress, KPI, deployment, registry, and final impact reports
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Fund Dano Finance to accelerate the DeFi Kernel as an open standard for shared liquidity, on-chain financial intents, and global order-book coordination on Cardano, including a registry, two DeFi primitives, and an SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for a 1% budget administration fee.
Dano Finance will deliver four outputs: a public DeFi Kernel registry, a Spot Leverage Order Book, an American Options Market-Making protocol, and a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.

The DeFi Kernel registry is intended to be open, fee-free, and royalty-free, with no payment, licensing fees, certification fees, listing fees, revenue share, or smart-contract open-sourcing required for registration.
Dano Finance says it currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.
The proposal claims Cardano DeFi is fragmented across liquidity, metadata, and execution paths, limiting market depth, integrations, and advanced financial applications.

The Spot Leverage Order Book will support leveraged spot trading intent involving collateral, borrowing, debt accounting, swap execution, risk parameters, position management, repayment, liquidation conditions, and settlement.
The American Options Protocol will use an extended concentrated-pool model to let liquidity providers supply capital and users buy or exercise pool-priced American options.

The SDK will help wallets, bots, indexers, market makers, and dApps discover on-chain financial intent, read registry metadata, construct transactions, and compose with DeFi Kernel-compatible contracts.

The proposal sets KPIs including mainnet deployments after security review, USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the order book within 90 days of launch, USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume within 90 days of launch, and at least one external SDK integration started or completed.

Dano Finance says it will return 5% of protocol fees generated by the Treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after specified direct costs, with public reporting.

summary: The document requests 3,333,000 ADA for Dano Finance to build DeFi Kernel registry infrastructure, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with Minswap Labs as budget administrator, milestone-based delivery, security review requirements, public reporting, adoption KPIs, and a limited protocol-fee return commitment.
